### 1. What the user expresses and how the simulator behaves
Lucia Serrano asks for one thing: get the paper temporary driver's license on file ("I want to get the temporary one on file with Wayfare"; old license expires 10-16). Lookup key: mobile 8015550186; verification on request: DOB 1988-03-14, then email. She authorises in general ("fine with the agent taking care of whatever their rules say has to be handled on your account for this") and executes the user-owned upload only when handed over with exact values, then reads back the expiry. Conditional lines: deactivation news, binder on file (uploaded "on the 6th"), inspection not redone. The simulator is passive/conditional.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now. Visible grounds: D1 "Documents are accepted on any agreement that is not closed: an agreement in applied, screening, active, on hold or deactivated status" (agreement is `on_hold`, will be `deactivated`); the temporary license hub "a Wayfare driver who has renewed a driver's license and holds the paper temporary license issued on renewal may ask to have it accepted". Before the acceptance days may be worked out, two waited-on states must be brought about (item 6).

### 4. Computations (frozen day 2026-10-11)

**A. Lapse allowance (document-lapse deactivation).** Computation sheet: allowance = level's standard document hold length (Schedule B: 90 on Comfort); deactivation date = hold start + allowance. Factor documents found from the records:
- lapsed insurance/license (record: agreement insurance_expiry 2026-07-01 ≤ day worked out) → −20;
- length of service (activated 2019-06-12, 2678 days ≥ 1825) → +10;
- Pro status (earnings account `Wayfare Pro Silver`, Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro) → +5;
- recent quality warnings (warnings 2025-11-03 [11 whole months, out] and 2026-05-11 [5 whole months, in] → exactly one) → −5;
- latest review rating (2026-06-08 review rating 4.88, in 4.80–4.89) → +4;
- lapse clock (lapsed document = earliest expiry among license 10-16, insurance 07-01, inspection 09-15, registration upload 2027-03-31 → auto insurance 2026-07-01; covering notices for 2026-07-01: seq 1 on 2026-06-01 and seq 2 on 2026-06-24 → clock from 2026-06-24; 2026-06-24 − 2026-07-02 = −8) → −8.
Allowance = 90−20+10+5−5+4−8 = **76**; deactivation date 2026-07-02+76 = **2026-09-16** (≤ today, hold still in place → owed). Fall-back (no factor) = 90 → 2026-09-30 (also owed; different allowance/date).

**B. Binder acceptance days (recording day 2026-10-11).** Baseline 45, then never below zero and capped last at days to printed end date. Factors:
- agreement standing (after A: deactivated, deactivation date 2026-09-16 ≤ recording day) → −6;
- insurance lapse (agreement insurance_expiry 2026-07-01 is 102 days before → >60) → −10;
- late insurance renewals (auto-insurance second notices: 2024-06-24 [27 whole months, out], 2025-06-24, 2026-06-24 → exactly two) → −6;
- Pro status & service length (Silver, active 2678 ≥ 1095) → +4;
- takeover clock (insurance expired 07-01 before upload date 10-06 → cover from upload date; 5 days upload→recording taken off) → −5;
- binder term (2026-10-06 → 2026-12-07 = 62 days ≥ 60) → +10.
45−6−10−6+4−5+10 = 32; cap = 57 days to 2026-12-07 → **32**; insurance expiry becomes **2026-11-12**. Fall-back = 45 → 2026-11-25. (If recorded before A, standing would read on-hold → −3 → 35.)

**C. Temporary license acceptance days (upload day 2026-10-11).** Baseline 30, never below one. Factors:
- agreement standing (deactivated 2026-09-16 ≤ upload day) → −8;
- background check recency (2026-02-10, 243 days → 180–364) → +3;
- late renewals, any document (second notices dated < 24 whole months: insurance 2025-06-24, 2026-06-24; inspection 2026-09-08; license 2026-10-09 → four; 2024-06-24 out) → −6;
- Pro status (Silver) → +3;
- short documents (Comfort: insurance + inspection; insurance after B 2026-11-12 = 32 days → not short; inspection 2026-09-15 past → short; one) → −6;
- license takeover (agreement license_expiry 2026-10-16 later than upload day → +5) → +5.
30−8+3−6+3−6+5 = **21**; license expiry becomes **2026-11-01**. Fall-back = 30 → 2026-11-10.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone
Problems: P_root = temporary license acceptance (customer's own write); P_bind = recording the uploaded insurance binder; P_deact = deactivation for document lapse.
Edges and order: P_deact → P_bind → P_root, and P_deact → P_root. Order: P_deact, P_bind, P_root.

- **Hop root ← binder (state-derived).** Sentence (temporary license hub): "The temporary license acceptance days are not worked out until the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement carries the accepted period of every insurance binder uploaded to the standing record." Records: auto_insurance upload 2026-10-06 (exp 2026-12-07) while agreement insurance_expiry_date = 2026-07-01 → state not held. Write found by searching the sentence's words ("auto insurance expiry date on the agreement", "insurance binder uploaded"): binder desk guidance "A binder updates the agreement only when support records it: the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement becomes the recording day plus the binder acceptance days … Until support records it, an uploaded binder leaves the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement as it was." (KB_search "auto insurance upload not yet on agreement expiry date" → rank 1.)
- **Hop root ← deactivation (state-derived).** Sentence (same hub): "Before the temporary license acceptance days are worked out, the agreement's status must already show the deactivation for document lapse owed by any document hold that has run past its lapse allowance." Records: status on_hold, document_expired since 2026-07-02; computation A gives run-out 2026-09-16 < today → owed and not shown. Write found: document-lapse deactivation reference ("a document hold that is still in place on the day its lapse allowance days run out ends in deactivation for document lapse … The agreement moves from on hold to deactivated for document lapse").
- **Hop binder ← deactivation (state-derived).** Sentence (binder desk guidance): "The binder acceptance days are fixed only after the agreement's status and deactivation date already show any deactivation for document lapse that its document hold has run into." Same records and write as above.
- P_deact carries no prerequisite sentence of its own; it waits on nothing.
No hop was pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, a route or a chain.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the temporary license": excluded — the hub's two prerequisite sentences make the acceptance days not yet workable while the binder is unrecorded and the owed deactivation unshown; the records show both states unmet.
- Alternative order binder-before-deactivation: excluded by the binder guidance's sentence; also the standing factor reads −3 vs −6.
- Alternative of lifting the hold instead: hold-release table "Expired document | an unexpired replacement document on file"; insurance and inspection are expired, and in any case D3 requires every required document unexpired; inspection 2026-09-15 expired → no lift.
- Recording an inspection: no vehicle_inspection upload on the record (inspection doc reads "the latest vehicle inspection upload"); excluded.
- Fall-back numbers (A 90 / B 45 / C 30) are definite and differ from 76 / 32 / 21.
- Factor findability: every factor document above was reached from record words (agreement dates, `Wayfare Pro Silver` + "Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro", standing-record second notices / quality warnings / rating reviews / upload rows); no computation document hinted at a variation.
